checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: Merkle batch anchors and inclusion proofs (merklock hashing transfer)

impact_assessment.why: The linear hash chain and anchor journal prove order and continuity, but not membership of a specific record in a batch without replaying the chain. merklock/hashing.py:38-104 provides domain-separated Merkle roots, proofs and verification with odd-node promotion.
impact_assessment.benefits: A .merkle sidecar commits a contiguous batch (start/end/root); a single record gets an O(log n) inclusion proof; a truncated log, changed digest or edited root is named; no change to the log format or rule behavior.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new telemetry/merkle.py and Telemetry.write_merkle_anchor; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: atomic sidecar write; state: sidecar only, not committed.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep leaves as existing record digests, domain-separate leaf/node hashes, validate anchor ranges and detached proofs, test odd/empty trees and tamper cases, and re-run the 200-test and AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: opt-in execution budgets for steps, LLM calls, tokens and wall time (neurocore transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Brain has max_steps and SelfModel counters, but no shared budget that stops a run before a dimension is exceeded. neurocore/core/execution_budget.py:51 provides limits, spend, time checks, pressure and a context variable.
impact_assessment.benefits: A budget can cap steps, backend calls, prompt tokens and wall time; Agent.run installs it around the loop, Planner spends per backend call/prompt, and a tight budget raises BudgetExceeded before the next action. Default None keeps behavior and actions byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Agent.run/run_task gain budget, Planner spends llm_calls/tokens; dependency: stdlib contextvars only; concurrency: budget is per-run context; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep budget opt-in; re-raise BudgetExceeded outside the backend fallback catch; test generous and tight step/LLM/token/time budgets, context scoping and snapshot; re-run 211 tests and AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: canonical episode identity and resume/new/ask policy (neurocore transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Brain's cold-start layouts and run headers do not carry a stable episode digest, so a changed task/seed/config cannot be distinguished from the same episode and there is no declared resume policy. neurocore/core/episode_identity.py:49-111 provides canonical projection, digest and resume decisions.
impact_assessment.benefits: Canonical JSON projection excludes volatile keys; input_digest binds task/seed/config/policy; run_task_logged headers carry episode_sha256; resume_decision returns resume/new/ask; prepare_resume pauses a refused candidate. Default action traces are unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new identity.py, header episode_sha256 field, no schema bump; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: header additive, no new table.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the digest additive; test volatile-field exclusion, changed target/seed, the full decision matrix, pause behavior and header equality across reruns; re-run 221 tests and AIKit gates.

[1/4] Plan: bind a deterministic workspace source hash into logged run headers (harness transfer)

impact_assessment.why: Brain run headers bind episode identity, policy and model manifests, but not the source tree that produced the run. harness/transcript.py:17 workspace_files and tools/replay.py:16 _hash_tree provide a relative-path -> sha256 map and a tree digest for replay evidence.
impact_assessment.benefits: An opt-in workspace_root writes workspace_sha256 into the header; identical source trees match, a changed source file changes the digest, and caches/logs/reports do not add noise. Default None keeps headers and actions unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new workspace.py, additive header field; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: no database/schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Define a stable skip set for .git/caches/logs/reports, sort relative paths, test changed/ignored files, bind only when workspace_root is supplied, and re-run 230 tests and AIKit gates.
